hero_kpi_rationale: Aurubis is undergoing a transformation toward a multimetal model focused on recycling, positioning it as a key player in the circular economy for industrial materials. This differentiating positioning is the main strategic driver.

risks.title: Dependence on complex recycled materials
risks.score_rationale: The risk is repeatedly mentioned in the report, with strong language on 'significant metallurgical challenges'. It is central to the recycling strategy and directly linked to core operations. The trend is stable, but critical for future growth.

risks.title: Competition for raw materials
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes the importance of securing flows of recycled materials. The language reflects increasing pressure on supply, with moderate to high intensity. A key category for the business model, trend on the rise.

risks.title: Strict environmental regulation
risks.score_rationale: The risk is strongly highlighted, with references to REACH, ISO audits, and legal proceedings in the United States. Central position in the 10-K, demanding language, stable but critical trend.

risks.title: Technical limits of energy efficiency
risks.score_rationale: The text clearly states that energy efficiency gains are becoming marginal despite high investments. Precise and technical language, important position in the report, stable trend.

risks.title: Integration of new recycling capacities
risks.score_rationale: The risk relates to the acquisition of Metallo and the integration of new technologies. Mentioned moderately, but with growing strategic implications. Trend on the rise.

risks.title: Fluctuating availability of renewable energy
risks.score_rationale: The report highlights the major challenge of dependence on intermittent renewable energy sources versus industrial processes requiring constant supply. Concerned tone, strategic position, trend on the rise.

risks.title: Management of industrial residues and by-products
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central to the business model, with repeated mentions of waste management, water and air emissions. Strong language, key environmental performance indicators monitored, stable trend.

risks.title: Dependence on energy-intensive electric processes
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes the importance of electric furnaces (such as at Metallo) and steam turbines. The risk is technological and operational, with moderate to high intensity. Stable trend.
